moments.text: Grey camera view looking down on a farm compound among trees and fields, magenta crosshair at centre, black redaction boxes.
A faint pale haze with a small red fleck flickers at the top edge, left of centre. 3 frames (~0.1 s): use frame step.
The pale haze and red fleck flash again at the top edge, slightly further left. About 0.15 s: use frame step.

notes: The glare is very faint at this resolution; the red flecks are the clearest part.
